chapters.label: Observe
chapters.text: Remember the contents and original positions of both cases.

chapters.label: Goal 1
chapters.text: Move the case containing the USB drive to the left tray.

chapters.label: Goal 2
chapters.text: Move the case containing the SD card to the right tray.

chapters.label: Goal 3
chapters.text: Return the USB case to its original position.

chapters.label: Observe
chapters.text: Remember where each toy started before they are moved into the left tray.

chapters.label: Goal 1
chapters.text: Move the toy that was originally on the left to the right tray.

chapters.label: Goal 2
chapters.text: Brush the spot where that toy originally stood, then return the brush.

chapters.label: Goal 3
chapters.text: Return the toy to its original position.
